entries.title: Satellite Briefing
entries.description: Real georeferenced satellite/aerial imagery with measured graphic overlays

engine.supplied_implementation: WebGL2 nested-raster plate shader plus a 2D overlay and geospatial preparation tools
requirements_and_inputs: Licence-clean, georeferenced imagery with dates and coordinate bounds; genuine measurements and imagery credits.
Imagery tools use standard-library Python, numpy, SciPy and Pillow; allow 3–4 GB for cached scenes.

constraints: Keep the ground photographic and geographically fixed; sparse white hairlines and one accent distinguish measurement from imagery.
Build orbit-to-ground zooms from nested plates using one camera/projection for imagery, marks, altitude and scale bar.
Change time with scans; use the colour-to-grey analyst grade deliberately and maintain slow camera movement.

entries.title: Engineering Briefing Board
entries.description: A physical enamel briefing wall carrying real photo cut-outs, marker measurements and props

engine.supplied_implementation: Supplied board kit with 2.5D parallax, ink, props, cut-out preparation and camera/readability checks
requirements_and_inputs: Licensed high-resolution photographs or user assets; keep FACTS.md and CREDITS, and measure resolution at the largest shot.
Optional ONNX BiRefNet matting; hand polygons or masks are an available alternative. Install extras in a project-private environment.

constraints: Use one continuous wall and camera travel; reveal the whole completed briefing only in the final pull-back.
Objects are real photographs with true proportions, shared lighting and physical placement; never substitute generated imagery as evidence.
Graphite labels, blue measurement/water and red decisions; rejected ideas erase into ghosts, and objects land with weight rather than UI pop easing.

entries.title: LiDAR Survey
entries.description: Real surveyed point clouds becoming measured terrain or surface models

engine.supplied_implementation: WebGL point/surface shaders, deterministic camera splines and Python survey-data tools
requirements_and_inputs: Actual LiDAR returns with positions/classification and truthful source or computed measurements.
Extra project dependencies include laspy, lazrs, scikit-image and optional fonttools/brotli.

constraints: Preserve every point’s measured position; classify, isolate and reveal layers without morphing points into invented shapes.
A shared world-space front turns the cloud into the surface; near-black staging, restrained colour and glow only at fronts/seams.
Camera moves continuously at 24 fps; any display relief exaggeration must be labelled and measurements use undistorted data.

entries.title: Projection on White Model
entries.description: Real architectural/geographic geometry as a matte white physical model, with data projected as light

engine.supplied_implementation: Three.js studio and projection shaders with a source-specific data adapter and measured overlay
requirements_and_inputs: Real footprints/heights or a user model; derive on-screen numbers from those same buildings.
The supplied prep.py is specific to 3DBAG/BGT/Dutch coordinates; other sources need an adapter to model.json.

constraints: Keep the model matte white at a stated scale; projected colour responds to surfaces and the projector throw rather than becoming a texture.
Introduce one data layer at a time through gestures of light inside a physical room/plinth setup.
No invented building attributes; the model stays still, the camera moves slowly and the sun/shadows follow a genuine place/date/time.

entries.title: Data Physicalization
entries.description: Published numerical data embodied as stacks of physical material units

engine.supplied_implementation: PBR instanced-object studio with HDRI reflections, AO/DOF and deterministic landing schedules
requirements_and_inputs: Real published or user-provided data with explicit unit conversions, sources and recorded rounding.
Studio HDRI and licensed textures; optional free instrument samples for the score.

constraints: State what one object equals; compared series use the same unit, exact counts/scales and a shared ruler material.
Use distinct tangible materials and studio lighting; growth is assembly of pieces, never bar scaling or shape morphing.
Land pieces with weight and material foley; keep landed objects fixed and include a reveal of the chart as a made object.

entries.title: Exploded Teardown
entries.description: An exact product disassembled into its real components in a photographed PBR studio

engine.supplied_implementation: Three.js r170; reusable CAD/PCB geometry, layout textures, projected labels and postprocessing
requirements_and_inputs: Product CAD/STEP/IGES/KiCad, BOM or assembly files and maker specifications; verify applicable licences.
Optional project-local occt-import-js for STEP triangulation and a studio HDRI.

constraints: Get geometry, component positions and counts from authoritative product files; keep material identity and real assembly orientation.
Explode layers along one axis with readable gaps; project leaders and dimensions from actual 3D anchors.
Smooth deterministic 24 fps, continuous exterior/macro camera travel, staggered separation and mechanically plausible closing.

entries.title: Microscope Story
entries.description: A real micrograph or whole-slide image explored across measured scales

engine.supplied_implementation: Registered plate pyramid, log-spiral camera, focus simulation, measured overlays and slide preparation
requirements_and_inputs: Licensed real micrographs/WSI with pixel size and registered levels; keep FACTS.md and measurement methods.
tifffile/imagecodecs for supported TIFF slides; some formats require OpenSlide or a custom adapter.

constraints: Do not generate or retouch the specimen; use one restrained stain-preserving grade and no false colour.
Make scale and focus the camera grammar: seamless nested plates, truthful scale bar, objective changes and focus breaths.
Anchor sparse marks to the specimen, show one measured reading at a time and describe measurements without diagnosing.

entries.title: Archive Light Table
entries.description: Authentic archive scans on a backlit physical light table, inspected through a loupe

engine.supplied_implementation: WebGL table/transmission/loupe shader, shared 2D world camera and archival scan preparation
requirements_and_inputs: Licensed/public-domain master scans and their real catalogue identifiers, dates and titles.
Base toolkit Python packages; chosen sample libraries only if the score needs them.

constraints: Preserve archive objects’ true proportions and damage; retain their own greys/paper tones with one signal colour.
Light comes from below and the loupe mediates every dive; changes of state occur inside the lens.
Glide continuously and use monotone motion; the underlying record stays fixed outside an explicitly staged photograph-space parallax move.

entries.title: Crayon Picture Book
entries.description: A wax-crayon picture-book page drawn and coloured before the viewer

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas drawing layers with WebGL2 wax-pressure/paper-tooth and watercolour-resist compositor
requirements_and_inputs: Design a new character model sheet using the supplied rig/drawing engine.

constraints: Simulate wax adhering to paper tooth by pressure; warm page, limited crayon palette, childlike perspective and colouring outside outlines.
Re-draw characters, lines and colouring at 12 fps with controlled boil; camera and wet wash progress at 24 fps.
Drawing/colouring is the story action; reveal strokes and hatching in order instead of applying a crayon filter to clean vectors.

entries.title: Watercolor Brush
entries.description: Transparent individual watercolour strokes on one warm fibrous paper sheet

engine.supplied_implementation: Deterministic JavaScript stroke ribbons, washes, parallax layers and sprite caching
requirements_and_inputs: Fixed-seed strokes and generated paper; any numerical annotation must use real data.

constraints: Use variable-width translucent ribbons and broken bristle tracks; overlaps darken and there are no clean vector outlines.
Paint structure before detail, then allow restrained sway; paper-coloured mist erases and brush-edge wipes reveal.
Keep paper and depth layers visible, warm and quiet; use smooth time-based motion, with 60 fps recommended for the fluid brush.

entries.title: Chinese Ink Wash
entries.description: Chinese ink painting on warm rice paper, with loaded wet/dry brushwork

engine.supplied_implementation: Brush/bristle drawing plus WebGL rice-paper, bleed, pigment and bloom compositor
requirements_and_inputs: Use the supplied engine/model-sheet views to establish subjects, brush character and pose.

constraints: Black ink in five tones and only one red for the seal; reserve most of the paper as empty space.
Forms come from loaded strokes, wet bleeding washes and dry flying-white bristles, never flat fills or outlined vectors.
Figures step at 12 fps while camera and natural effects move at 24; stabilize stroke seeds and paint things into existence.

entries.title: Impasto Oil Painting
entries.description: Opaque palette-knife oil painting with physically legible paint ridges

engine.supplied_implementation: Impasto renderer and reference-to-stroke engine using height-field raking light
requirements_and_inputs: First design a readable value-planned reference illustration; convert shape groups to controlled strokes.

constraints: Make each stroke a paint object with ridges, lift-off lips and dragged colours; use shape-confined coarse-to-fine knife work.
Keep static paint static; only story-moving objects repaint from fixed seeds, smoothly at 24 fps.
Use thin underpainting and explicit reflection dabs, 2× supersampling and no film grain; avoid indiscriminate boiling or painterly-photo filters.

entries.title: One-line Drawing
entries.description: One continuously drawn ink line on warm paper

engine.supplied_implementation: SVG-path arc-length sampling, pressure/bleed ink renderer and nib-follow camera
requirements_and_inputs: Author one continuous path and its chapter/beat markers; retracing is allowed.

constraints: The pen never lifts; all subjects remain linework with no filled scenery or shading, and at most one accent used once.
Pressure follows drawing speed; paper texture stays anchored and only a soft pen/hand shadow suggests the real world.
Continuous 24 fps with curvature-aware drawing speed and a following camera; important strokes slow down and musical marks control timing.

entries.title: Whiteboard Explainer
entries.description: A physical dry-erase whiteboard lesson written in real stroke order, without hands

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas board/ink/props engine with floating pens, stroke-font lettering, scheduled writing and camera
requirements_and_inputs: Single-line font and scheduled stroke windows; narration/content must fit the drawing time.

constraints: Use one spatial board map, real marker pooling/dry streaks, old lesson ghosts and a drifting glossy sheen.
No hands, arms or cursor: floating markers, magnets and eraser are the physical actors, each with shadows and foley.
Write in actual stroke order with slow-fast-slow hand timing; erasing leaves ghosts and the camera travels among related ideas.

entries.title: Urban Sketch · Pen & Wash
entries.description: Location-reportage fineliner drawing with a visibly separate transparent watercolour wash

engine.supplied_implementation: Pen/wash drawing and colour-arrival fields with a WebGL page compositor
requirements_and_inputs: Model subjects with the supplied pen/wash engine and preserve page-scale paper texture.

constraints: Thin sepia ink has gaps and corner overshoots; washes misregister by 1–3 px, pool and leave white reserves.
Keep the page’s ragged unpainted edges; do not turn the scene into edge-to-edge finished illustration.
Figures boil at 12 fps but the static page does not; colour blooms through a wet front and the camera remains smooth.

entries.title: Shadow Puppetry
entries.description: Translucent dyed-hide puppets behind cloth, illuminated by warm oil lamps

engine.supplied_implementation: Carved-piece drawing and jointed rigs with WebGL2 lamp × transmission × cloth compositing
requirements_and_inputs: Design carved model sheets and jointed figures; pre-simulate loose pendulum/spring parts deterministically.

constraints: Colour comes through hide; carved holes shine and multiply overlaps darken, with visible rivets and control rods.
Puppets are rigid pieces rotated/slid on joints, never morphed; hand tremor and loose-part swing convey live theatre.
Continuous 24 fps for puppet/camera motion, lamp flicker and press-to-screen focus changes; effect swaps alone may step at 12 fps.

entries.title: Ukiyo-e
entries.description: Complete Japanese woodblock-print sheets, with separate printed colour blocks

engine.supplied_implementation: Cached Canvas colour/key blocks, print textures, bokashi and a scroll/camera timeline
requirements_and_inputs: Author each scene as a complete print with its border, cartouche, seal and block separations.

constraints: Use visible washi, slightly misregistered colour blocks, black keylines, woodgrain, baren streaks and bokashi.
Keep deliberate flatness; depth comes from layers, mist and cropping, never perspective lighting.
Most of a print is still; figures/nature at 8 fps, fast rain/water at 12 and camera at 24; reveal blocks with a baren sweep.

entries.title: Red Paper-cut
entries.description: Opaque, front-lit red cut-paper folk art with jointed figures and physical cutting/folding

engine.supplied_implementation: Paper-piece builder, folk motifs, affine rigs, folding/light modules and cut-letter HUD
requirements_and_inputs: Design cut-outs that could physically remain connected; use replaceable facial pieces rather than morphs.

constraints: Everything is cut paper: holes provide detail, no painted gradients or outline strokes; include grain, cut faces and thickness shadows.
Preserve bridges and connected islands in the cut pattern, with red hero paper and opaque front lighting.
Figures step at 12 fps around rivets; camera/light/weather move at 24, and folding/cutting reveal actual paper operations.

entries.title: Paper-cut Lightbox
entries.description: A shallow physical paper-cut lightbox with stacked parallel sheets and luminous openings

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas2D layer art mapped to lit 3D planes, shadowed stage and DOF/bloom postprocessing
requirements_and_inputs: Metre-based shallow-box geometry; each sheet must fit within the cavity and retain its shadow.

constraints: Depth is a value ladder from lighter/cooler rear paper to almost-black front paper, with edge light, bottom shade and real layer shadows.
Light through paper and emissive holes are major actions; paper itself slides/rotates rigidly with no morphing or bending.
Use smooth 30 fps, restrained hand-held micro-drift, staggered light cues and spoken-word-timed impacts.

entries.title: Risograph Print
entries.description: Two- or three-spot-ink risograph printing on warm paper

engine.supplied_implementation: RGB density channels as ink plates, Canvas drawing helpers and WebGL2 print shader
requirements_and_inputs: Choose a small spot-ink palette and design plate/knockout relationships before animation.

constraints: Multiply translucent inks with misregistration, halftone screens, pinholes and feed-direction unevenness.
At most two plates per area and at most one as a tint; use paper-white knockout halos to preserve subjects.
Characters act at 12 fps, camera at 24; registration stays fixed per shot except deliberate musical kicks/drifts.

entries.title: Halftone Dossier
entries.description: Printed bureaucratic dossier cards with halftone exhibits and animated mascots

engine.supplied_implementation: Self-contained HTML/SVG/Canvas scene helpers, halftone, stamps, grain and deterministic render(t)
requirements_and_inputs: Design one clear headline, exhibit/gag and caption per short card.

constraints: All shading is printed halftone on cream paper; never luminous gradients or glossy digital effects.
Use case numbers, stamps, file chips and serious evidence framing; one idea per 2–4-second card.
30 fps transforms with character-only line boil; overshoot entrances, glyph pops and stamp slams, with dot-wipe transitions.

entries.title: Woodcut Print
entries.description: Relief woodcut impressions, white cuts removed from black ink on laid paper

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas carving/mask/print compositor with shape hatching and physical paper-peel transitions
requirements_and_inputs: Design form-following knife/V-gouge/U-gouge cuts and a fixed paper margin.

constraints: Light is carved away from black, not drawn as dark lines on white; hatch directions follow form and widths express tone.
Reveal coarse gouges before fine cuts; the block’s mirror reversal and paper pull are native transitions.
Figures step at 12 fps while camera/fire/light run at 24; hatch strokes stay attached to body parts and the paper margin stays fixed.

entries.title: Copperplate Engraving
entries.description: Copperplate intaglio line engraving, optionally hand-coloured afterward

engine.supplied_implementation: Ordered burin-stroke/hatching engine with paper/plate marks, text, roundels and transparent wash
requirements_and_inputs: Use shape/light fields to generate hatching and clear occlusion; optional SVG outlines can seed new figures.

constraints: Make tone from one to three crossing line families; no grey fills, and every line swells/tapers like a cut groove.
Keep one light direction, paper/plate marks and geometrically occluded strokes; optional colour multiplies over the finished print.
Animate cutting order and ragged wash blooms; avoid ordinary UI fades/slides.

entries.title: Silkscreen Travel Poster
entries.description: An opaque spot-ink travel poster physically screen-printed in successive pulls

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas2D Path2D ink, squeegee, screen-frame, poster-layout and plane-transition kit
requirements_and_inputs: Separate artwork into printable shape layers and a clear poster information band.

constraints: Each ink is opaque and covers earlier inks; no halftone, linework or gradients—use flat stepped bands.
Use 1–3 px registration offsets, ink thickness rims, fresh wet sheen and restrained cream-paper texture.
Steady linear squeegee pulls and beat-based printing, never fades; re-inking changes palette without changing geometry.

entries.title: Swiss Motion Graphics
entries.description: Pure flat typographic motion design on a rigorous modular grid

engine.supplied_implementation: 2D layout/camera system with clip reveals, grid snapping and shared score data
requirements_and_inputs: Design a content-specific grid and beat-based timing; use the shared score data if music drives the bars.

constraints: Paper, black type/bars, light greys and one saturated signal colour; no gradients, shadows, grain or particles.
Everything snaps to the grid and lands on beats except one deliberately meaningful exception; extreme type-scale contrast is structural.
Only cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1) snaps and linear movement; no spring/bounce/overshoot, with wipe/clip entrances and knife-cut deletion.

entries.title: 60s Spy Title Sequence
entries.description: A four-ink 1960s-style title story built from hand-cut paper silhouettes and type

engine.supplied_implementation: Cached cut-paper shapes, font-outline recutting, silhouette rigs and tempo-driven timeline
requirements_and_inputs: Use an appropriately licensed condensed display font; establish a new silhouette cast and one story goal.

constraints: Flat opaque inks, scissor-cut edges, cut gaps and small paper shadows; type becomes architecture and props.
Act in silhouette and timing, keeping four colours and no gradients or halftone.
Puppets/landings at 12 fps, camera/credit slides at 24; brass stabs motivate cuts and full-picture stop-time.

entries.title: Art Deco
entries.description: Gold-keylined, airbrushed Art Deco volumes on warm lacquer black

engine.supplied_implementation: Deterministic Canvas2D gold/airbrush/motif kit with pinhole camera and bulb typography
requirements_and_inputs: Build around one vertical axis and consistent light direction, using structural ornament rather than decoration stickers.

constraints: Use banded metallic gold, engraved keylines and hard-edged airbrushed volumes; black is warm and architecture stays axial.
Sunbursts, stepped arches, dials and marquees carry framing, progress and transitions.
Motion unfolds mechanically from the centre; figures step at 12 fps while camera/light/gold sweeps run at 24 and land on score hits.

entries.title: Blueprint
entries.description: A technical 2D drawing on one Prussian-blue cyanotype sheet

engine.supplied_implementation: Drafting/draw-on engine with WebGL2 paper, ink bleed, stains and shadows
requirements_and_inputs: Choose correct drafting conventions and mechanically coherent dimensions/gear relationships.

constraints: Use white line weights, centre/hidden/cutting lines, hatching, dimensions and a title block on one physical sheet.
Allow orthographic or oblique/isometric drawings but no 3D rendering; the designed object acts through its parts.
Draw centre lines before outlines/detail/hatching/dimensions/labels; camera and draw-on at 24 fps, mechanisms and exploded parts on a beat grid.

entries.title: Stained Glass
entries.description: Coloured glass panes in lead cames inside a stone room, illuminated by sunlight

engine.supplied_implementation: Rigid glass-piece rigs and WebGL2 backlight/transmission/room/floor-projection compositor
requirements_and_inputs: Design physically plausible cut pieces and lead networks, with secular subject matter under this upstream style.

constraints: Glass glows only with backlight and throws soft colour onto the floor; preserve material texture, grisaille and the surrounding room.
Pieces remain rigid with no bending/morphing; subjects become visible through illumination rather than fades.
Figures step at 8 fps while light/camera/dust run at 24; freeze figures when the moving light leaves them.

entries.title: Pictogram Motion
entries.description: Beat-paced catalogue cards combining pictograms, huge bilingual titles and a mono index

engine.supplied_implementation: Flat Canvas2D pattern/pictogram/pose engine and beat edit list
requirements_and_inputs: A coherent item list/chapter structure, one tempo and an original pictogram action for each card.

constraints: Five tones of one chapter hue, square-cell discs/motifs and whole rows shifted sideways establish the visual system.
One pictogram performs one action beside architectural heavy type and an index; figures are flat rounded bars/disc heads.
Shots/actions land on beats, type uses mask slides and figures assemble in bands; transitions use grid rows/columns/tiles rather than arbitrary fades.

entries.title: ASCII / CRT Terminal
entries.description: Real character-grid images on a monochrome amber or green CRT terminal

engine.supplied_implementation: Glyph atlas, measured density ramps, negative-to-cell sampler and WebGL2 CRT post
requirements_and_inputs: A licensed monospace bitmap-style font and deliberately readable grayscale/silhouette source scenes.

constraints: Every image and subtitle uses actual grid glyphs; no image with an ASCII filter, free sprites or vector HUD panels.
Use one phosphor ramp, negative space and CRT glass/scanline physics; the camera changes grid font size.
Typing/scrolling/counters stay cell-snapped; only grid scale, CRT physics and declared transformation particles move continuously.

entries.title: Data Storytelling
entries.description: A real chart told as a film, with pencil annotation on warm paper

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas2D chart/shape/pencil/camera kit with data-space annotation and optional sonification
requirements_and_inputs: Traceable, openly licensed or user data; choose the chart type the question and data require.

constraints: Every visual mark maps to a genuine number; alter framing without altering values.
Use warm paper/ink, measured axes and handwritten notes pinned in data space, with a physical red–blue pencil actor.
Motion expresses meaningful chart operations and data rhythm; rescales/morphs/axis growth replace dissolves or blank transitions.

entries.title: Isometric Infographic
entries.description: Flat true-isometric systems and cutaway dioramas, with exact icon quantities

engine.supplied_implementation: Dependency-free Canvas2D isometric projection and depth-sorted solids/infographic kit
requirements_and_inputs: Use numerically correct Isotype quantities and a fixed 30-degree-axis projection.

constraints: No perspective, rotating projection or outlines on solids; distinguish faces with three derived tones.
Build the system on a floating cross-section board; leaders, routes, cuts, pins and legends live in its world.
Draw a leading line before movement/cutaway; assemble countable icons on the beat and use motion, not transparent fading, for solid arrivals.

entries.title: Dark Tech Keynote
entries.description: Precisely animated original software UI on a softly lit near-black stage

engine.supplied_implementation: Canvas2D ES-module UI kit, light reveal and strip-based 2.5D perspective
requirements_and_inputs: Create an original drawn-code interface and one brand accent; this profile does not depict a real operating system.

constraints: Use raised dark surfaces, a restrained hairline grid and cool light; one accent belongs to the current focus.
All UI and camera motion land on grid and beat with fast-out motion, one small overshoot and immediate settling.
Light reveals, curved flights and a living cursor carry cause/effect; no grain, arbitrary fading or independent stage drift.

entries.title: Living Screencast
entries.description: Faithful redrawn real-product UI in HTML/CSS/SVG with a low-resolution pixel mascot

engine.supplied_implementation: DOM-based UI state, measured element anchors, sprite actor/cursor timelines and camera wrappers
requirements_and_inputs: Verify current real product labels, shortcuts and coherent demo content; replace the supplied sprite with an original mascot.
Measure live DOM anchors each frame; prepare spoken-word timings when using narration.

constraints: Keep high-resolution product UI sharp and exact while the mascot and its props share a hard square-pixel grid.
Cursor represents the user, mascot the software; every action causes a genuine scripted state change and no hand appears.
30 fps UI motion with mascot pixel-snapping; focus and whip blur must never obscure text the viewer needs to read.

entries.title: Sci-fi Hologram HUD
entries.description: A luminous line-wireframe subject scanned over a projector pad with measurement HUD

engine.supplied_implementation: Supplied wireframe/projection/scan/explode engine plus HUD and model primitives
requirements_and_inputs: Build physically connected model topology and compute displayed values; normalize models for the camera kit.

constraints: Keep the subject a light wireframe, with background grid, projector subject layer and faster-parallax foreground instruments.
Reserve hot edges for the active scan/front/part; protect all text with dark plates away from wireframe clutter.
Smooth 24 fps, axis-correct explosions and sequenced target/leader/value animations; scan or loupe transitions replace internal cuts/fades.

entries.title: 1930s Rubber Hose Cartoon
entries.description: Early-sound-era black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon projected through a worn 4:3 film gate

engine.supplied_implementation: Constant-width ink/boil engine, flexible character rigs, watercolour backgrounds and film-damage pass
requirements_and_inputs: Use original characters and a tempo whose beat is an even whole number of 24 fps frames.

constraints: Noodle limbs without knees/elbows, pie eyes, white four-finger gloves and flat character fills against soft grey backgrounds.
Characters and props breathe in phase with music, with full anticipation/hold/action and elastic squash/stretch.
Characters/boil at 12 fps and camera at 24; maintain rounded 4:3 projection, optical wear and period sound treatment.

entries.title: 80s Cel Anime
entries.description: 1980s cel animation with painted backgrounds, backlit effects and VHS/CRT playback

engine.supplied_implementation: Cel-path/rig and painted-plate modules with WebGL tape/CRT postprocessing
requirements_and_inputs: Build original colour-model/model sheets with separate colour and emissive background plates.

constraints: Maintain all four layers: soft painted backgrounds, hard-shadow flat cels, backlit light and videotape/CRT treatment.
Use coloured outlines and period almond-eye facial construction; gradients belong in backgrounds, not cel shapes.
Characters at 12 fps, selected performance beats at 8, camera/light/weather at 24; hold peaks and move light across held drawings.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Sitcom Toon
entries.description: Original adult sci-fi sitcom animation with boiling heavy outlines and dialogue-led acting

engine.supplied_implementation: Screen-space line/flat-shading vector engine, parametric face rigs and audio-derived lip-sync tools
requirements_and_inputs: Invent a distinct original cast/world; prepare dialogue and per-character lip-sync envelopes.

constraints: Thick constant screen-space outlines boil, fills/shadows stay flat and hard, with large white eyes and elastic mouths.
Use a small mundane goal and excessive sci-fi means, performed through interruptions, pauses, reactions and escalation.
Characters/boil/lips at 12 fps, camera/effects at 24; prioritize held acting and anticipation over continuous movement.

entries.title: Mid-century Cartoon
entries.description: Mid-century instructional cartoon with off-register printed cels and economical presenter acting

engine.supplied_implementation: Two-plate Canvas drawing/text/shape engine with presenter rig, icons and instructional callouts
requirements_and_inputs: Design a coherent presenter/product instructional sequence with original geometric characters.

constraints: Flat colour fills offset from breathing broken ink lines, restrained paper texture and minimal planar settings.
Presenter body holds while hands/arms/eyes/mouth act; shade with one hard flat plane, not gradients.
Poses/registration at 12 fps and camera/diagram routes at 24; hand actions anticipate and land exactly on beats.

entries.title: 16-bit Pixel RPG
entries.description: A true indexed-palette 16-bit-style RPG film at native 320×180 resolution

engine.supplied_implementation: Indexed framebuffer, palette lookup tables, Bayer dither, sprite/portrait/UI modules
requirements_and_inputs: A limited licensed palette and native-pixel typography/graphics; nearest-neighbour ×6 output scaling.

constraints: Everything lives in the framebuffer with integer-pixel cameras; use ordered dither and palette changes, never smooth blends.
Tell the story through genuine game language—dialogue portraits, menus, battles, saves and item fanfares.
Sprite cycles at 8–12 fps inside 24 fps output; use palette/mosaic/encounter transitions, no CRT scanlines, bloom or alpha fades.

entries.title: HD-2D
entries.description: Pixel-art sprites inside a genuinely lit 3D miniature set

engine.supplied_implementation: Three.js pixel-textured geometry and lit billboards with DOF/tilt-shift/bloom post
requirements_and_inputs: Constant world-space texel density, nearest filtering and original pixel characters/pose tables.

constraints: Keep the contrast between flat low-res stepped characters and smooth real 3D lighting, shadow, particles and camera.
High/far camera and tilt-shift band make the set miniature; practical lights cast sprite shadows and need front fill.
Sprites use few-frame cycles; camera/light/focus update each 60 fps output frame, with no film grain.

entries.title: Microgame Frenzy
entries.title_zh: 微游戏快闪（瓦里奥制造式）
entries.description: A connected sequence of very short games, each redrawn in a distinct material/graphic medium

engine.supplied_implementation: Home-stage toon kit, per-medium scene modules, WebGL material passes and shared accelerating timeline
requirements_and_inputs: Design stakes/lives and one verb/result per game; model-sheet the same hero’s silhouette marks in every medium.

constraints: A command plus one action/result in 2.5–4 seconds; return to one fixed host/home-stage look between games.
Each medium must use its own meaningful material/rendering trick, not a superficial filter.
Accelerate tempo, duration, dwell, command hold and drawing rate together; enter/leave through the home screen, with a beat-accurate timer.

entries.title: Game Show Flat
entries.description: Flat, saturated toy-character game-show rounds driven by one fast beat grid

engine.supplied_implementation: SVG or Canvas vector helpers, reusable rounds/characters and event-generated music/SFX
requirements_and_inputs: A single fixed tempo and a timeline shared by picture and score; each round needs a repeated verb and readable judgement.

constraints: One thick outline, flat fills, hard offset shadows and same-hue patterns; no gradients, blur or soft texture.
Characters share a bean/toy construction and perform hops, squash and shouts on beats.
Every entrance, typewriter reveal, hit and cut sits on a beat/subdivision; rounds hard-cut on bar lines.

entries.title: 1920s Silent Film
entries.description: A silent-era ink/washed-grey one-reeler projected inside a 4:3 theatre gate

engine.supplied_implementation: Tonal drawing and 2.5D rigs, WebGL2 redraw/film-damage passes and intertitle/theatre kit
requirements_and_inputs: Tell the narrative through physical action and intertitles; use only cinema instrument/projector sound.

constraints: Maintain inked grey/hatching images with silver-print wear, flicker, weave and curtains around a 4:3 gate.
Nobody speaks; wide-shot body acting and intertitles carry meaning without voice-over.
Hand-crank character/camera sampling around 16 fps within 24 fps projection effects; speed shifts express emotion.

entries.title: Liminal Found Footage
entries.description: One first-person 1990s VHS camcorder take through an empty, repeating interior

engine.supplied_implementation: Procedural 3D room/light/fog shaders, handheld camera timeline and VHS/OSD postprocessing
requirements_and_inputs: Author a continuous route and focus/exposure/fear curves through coherent interior geometry.

constraints: Use a familiar-but-wrong empty place, flat fluorescent light and bureaucratic signs; dread comes from space and camera failure, not monsters.
Render low-resolution 4:3 and upscale through tape treatment; avoid polished CG and exaggerated decay.
Continuous handheld gait/breath/tremor, searching autofocus and delayed exposure; cuts occur only as tape/recording breaks.

entries.title: Brick Toy
entries.description: Rigid brick-built toys on a real household surface, photographed with a macro lens

engine.supplied_implementation: 3D bevelled-brick/plastic/actor kit, HDRI/softbox set and deterministic rigid-body sequences
requirements_and_inputs: True stud scale, licensed real-surface assets/HDRI, ambient occlusion and pre-simulated falls.

constraints: Glossy ABS, studs, bevels and seam AO; original brick-built figures without branded lettering or minifigure silhouette.
Keep real room objects at human scale to contrast with the tiny toy world.
Bricks/characters hold 12 fps poses while camera/focus move at 24; pieces snap/click and remain rigid, with no deformation.

entries.title: Paper Pop-up Book
entries.description: Graphic cut-paper cards popping from a real hardcover book on a macro-photographed desk

engine.supplied_implementation: Three.js r170 plus Canvas2D paper art, cut-out shadows, book hinges/curl and physical DOF
requirements_and_inputs: Metre-based book/character scales, licensed room assets/HDRI and actual cut-out depth/shadow materials.

constraints: Contrast flat saturated outlined paper with photoreal room lighting, cardboard thickness, off-white borders and shallow focus.
Set pieces rise around their bottom edge, back to front; characters stay flat cards and turn with a scale flip.
Smooth time-based camera, preferably 60 fps, with quantized pose redraws and physical page curl; the room remains still.

entries.title: Tilt-Shift Miniature
entries.description: A photoreal world made miniature by a high viewpoint, narrow focus band and time-lapse clock

engine.supplied_implementation: 3D procedural world/traffic/sun systems with physical DOF plus screen-space tilt-shift band
requirements_and_inputs: Pre-computed system simulations and art-directed hero timing; track the focus band to the subject.

constraints: High oblique/top-down long-lens views, saturated sunny colour and narrow sharp band establish the miniature illusion.
Keep the world photoreal rather than toy-shaded; use genuine light/shadow and restrained atmosphere.
Time-lapse actors/systems hold at a low rate (for example 8 Hz) while camera stays smooth; remove stutter as action returns to real time.

entries.title: Low-poly Isometric Island
entries.description: A flat-shaded low-poly floating world viewed through fixed isometric orthographic projection

engine.supplied_implementation: Three.js hex terrain/primitive props, faceted sea shader and orthographic post chain
requirements_and_inputs: Primitive low-poly geometry, material/light palette and shared beat-based growth/event schedule.

constraints: No textures or smooth shading; use faceted geometry, hex-column land, primitive props and visible tile seams.
Keep orthographic isometric projection and no horizon; moving light changes time and distant geometry dissolves into screen-space sky.
Smooth 24 fps with eased rise/drop/pop curves; growth density accelerates on the music grid while projection remains fixed.

entries.title: Glass Product Render
entries.description: A fictional glass/metal hero object in an infinite black strip-lit studio

engine.supplied_implementation: Three.js physical transmission/dispersion materials with per-frame strip-scene PMREM and beat timeline
requirements_and_inputs: Invent original product geometry; use a three.js version supporting dispersion (the supplied project is r170).

constraints: Glass is defined by physical strip-light reflection/refraction and visible internals; do not use a cluttered photographic studio HDRI.
Preserve distinct clear/frosted glass and metal, with light physically behind/inside frosted parts.
Smooth drifting camera, precise eased assembly/explosion and beat-timed sweeps/pulses; avoid real branded silhouettes or UI.

entries.title: Twoclipping-inspired UI Morph Loop
entries.description: Continuous light UI transformations with a causal cursor and restrained analytical springs.

entries.title: Twoclipping-inspired Product Launch
entries.description: A light 2D product film connecting interface actions, optional imagery and a useful outcome.

entries.title: Silent-era 3D Dogfight, Tinted Ortho B&W
entries.title_zh: 默片 3D 空战 · 正色片黑白 + 琥珀染色
entries.description: A three.js dogfight graded like a 1927 orthochromatic print: white skies, deep blacks, an amber tint, gate weave and scratches. Wings is remembered for aerial combat shot from cameras strapped to the planes, so most cameras here ride on the planes.

entries.title: Black-Gold Art Deco Revue Poster
entries.title_zh: 黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报
entries.description: An Art Deco revue poster in black, gold and silver: airbrushed gradients, a stepped proscenium, a chrome condenser mic. It is 1929 Broadway at the height of Deco, and the film where sound arrives, so rings of sound pour out of the mic.

entries.title: Kollwitz Anti-war Woodcut
aliases: All Quiet on the Western Front
entries.description: A woodcut after Käthe Kollwitz: big masses of black, white knife-cut contours, rough grain, with Clawd printed from its own orange block. Kollwitz's German anti-war prints of 1921–22 come from the same war and the same grief as the film.
entries.film: All Quiet on the Western Front

entries.title: 1889 Sepia Albumen Panorama
entries.description: A gold-toned albumen panorama of 1889: soft lens, a little pan blur, cream highlights and umber shadows, silver grain; only Clawd is hand-tinted. Cimarron opens on the 1889 land rush, so it is shot as a photograph of that year, keeping the chapter monochrome.

entries.title: MGM Silver B&W 3D Lobby
entries.title_zh: 米高梅银色黑白 3D 大堂
entries.description: A three.js model of the circular lobby, graded in MGM's silver black and white with Clawd's orange as the only colour. The film's best-known image is the shot straight down the well, galleries closing in rings, so the set is built around it.

entries.title: Mucha Art Nouveau Panel
entries.description: A Mucha-style Art Nouveau panel: swelling brown outlines, pastel flats, a mosaic ground and a halo behind the central figure. Cavalcade opens on New Year's Eve 1899 with a family toasting the new century, so the halo is a clock striking twelve.

entries.title: 1930s B&W Rubber-hose Cartoon
entries.description: A 1934 black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon: thick-thin ink, pie-cut eyes, white gloves, cel shading over grey watercolour backgrounds, with film grain. It is the film's own year, and a road comedy gag suits cartoon timing.

entries.title: Admiralty Sea Chart Copperplate
entries.description: An 18th-century Admiralty sea chart engraved in copperplate, with rhumb lines, compass roses, soundings and thin hand colour; the Bounty is a ship vignette on the sheet. The film is a voyage, so the whole film stays on the chart.

entries.title: Silver B&W 3D Wedding-cake Stage
entries.title_zh: 银色黑白 3D 螺旋婚礼蛋糕舞台
entries.description: A three.js model of the revolving spiral 'wedding cake' stage in MGM's silver black and white: satin, chiffon and ostrich feathers against deep black, Clawd the only colour. The 175-step spiral of 'A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody' is the film's famous set piece.

entries.title: Newsprint Letterpress and Line Engraving
entries.title_zh: 报纸活字印刷 + 线刻插图
entries.description: Letterpress newsprint with 1890s line engraving: a wood-type headline, dense columns of lead type, ink spread and under-inking on yellowed paper, figures in hatching. The film's best-known image is L'Aurore's 'J'Accuse…!' front page of 13 January 1898.

entries.title: WPA Silkscreen Poster
aliases: You Can't Take It with You
entries.description: A 1930s WPA silkscreen poster: six flat opaque inks, split-fountain gradients, slight misregistration on rag paper. The Federal Art Project posters of 1936–39 were American graphic design of the film's own years, and they keep it apart from No. 10's newsprint.
entries.film: You Can't Take It with You

entries.title: Technicolor Impasto Oil
entries.description: Impasto oil with palette-knife slabs, ridged paint and Technicolor heat: skies burning from gold to blood red, red earth, black silhouettes. Gone with the Wind is where colour arrives in the film, so Tara at sunset is the first fully saturated frame.

entries.title: Gothic Charcoal Drawing
entries.description: Charcoal on toothed paper: velvet blacks, smudged greys, moonlight and mist lifted out with an eraser. Hitchcock's Rebecca is a black-and-white Gothic dream of a house in mist and then in flames, and charcoal can draw both.

entries.title: Welsh Valley Gouache
entries.description: Opaque gouache in the 1941 poster's gold and green: solid colour masses, coal-black tips, Kyffin Williams' heavy dark hills and broken contours. It replaced a woodcut that repeated No. 3; the scene is the colliers walking home down the valley, singing.

entries.title: Home Front Stone Lithograph
uses: Stone lithograph with crayon shadow plate
Frank Newbould and Abram Games WWII posters
entries.description: A WWII British Home Front lithograph poster: flat brick red, deep green, cream and grey-blue, with a grainy crayon shadow plate. It fits the film's last scene, a village singing in its bombed church while Spitfires pass overhead.

entries.title: Studio Glamour Black-and-White
entries.description: The film's own look, Arthur Edeson's studio black-and-white, painted as a retouched glamour still: rich greys, soft-focus close-ups with catchlights, venetian-blind shadows, light shafts in smoke and fog. Clawd, as Rick, is the only colour.

entries.title: Backlit Gothic Stained Glass
entries.description: Backlit Gothic stained glass: leaded pot-metal pieces with grisaille-painted faces, Chartres blue, ruby borders, and coloured light pooling on the church floor. Father O'Malley's boys' choir is set into the window under a gold star for 'Swinging on a Star'.

entries.title: Typewriter Character Art
entries.description: The picture is typed: monospaced characters on a pica grid, grey built from character density and overstrikes, uneven ribbon ink on bond paper. Don Birnam lugs his typewriter to the pawnshops, so his own machine types the street; Clawd is struck in orange ribbon.

entries.title: Picture-Magazine Halftone Spread
entries.title_zh: 画报新闻摄影半调跨页
aliases: The Best Years of Our Lives
entries.description: A 1946 picture-magazine news photo printed in coarse black halftone on coated stock, with the gutter fold and an overprinted caption. Deep-focus rows of stripped B-17s run to the horizon; Clawd is the only colour, on its own spot-orange plate.
entries.film: The Best Years of Our Lives

entries.title: 1940s Graphite Magazine Illustration
entries.description: Graphite pencil in the manner of 1940s magazine illustration: construction lines, near-parallel hatching passes, rubbed darks and eraser lifts on toothy paper. The drawing builds itself around a polite refusal at a hotel desk; Clawd alone is in coloured pencil.

entries.title: Deep-Focus Fog Castle, 3D B&W
entries.description: A real-time 3D Elsinore in high-contrast deep-focus black-and-white: volumetric fog, wet stone, swells breaking into lace foam, silver grain. It follows Olivier's castle, foggy battlements and sea rock; Clawd is the only colour, lifting Yorick's skull.

entries.title: Wood-Type Campaign Poster
entries.description: A Southern campaign poster in wood-type letterpress: red, blue and black ink on cream stock, wood grain in the solids, starved patches, misregistered formes and halftone portraits. It is Willie Stark's rally; Clawd is printed in a fourth, orange ink.

entries.title: Hirschfeld One-Line Caricature
entries.title_zh: 赫希菲尔德一笔画漫画
entries.description: Al Hirschfeld's Broadway caricature: one flowing ink line that swells and tapers, solid blacks against white, lots of empty paper, one exaggerated trait per person. The film is about the theatre, so its party is drawn as a theatre-page cartoon; Clawd is the only colour.

entries.title: Dufy Watercolour Ballet
uses: Loose ink line over offset colour
entries.description: Raoul Dufy's watercolour: fast blue-black ink lines over big transparent patches of cobalt, lemon and rose that never line up with them. The film's closing ballet was designed after Dufy, so the Place de la Concorde and its dancers are painted his way.

entries.title: Strobridge Circus Lithograph
uses: Flat ink with heavy black outline
entries.description: A Strobridge circus lithograph: flat chrome yellow, vermilion and cobalt with heavy black outlines, screened and slightly off register on grainy stone. DeMille's big top becomes a three-ring poster, with Clawd as the Great Sebastian making the poster's trapeze catch.

entries.title: High-Key Beach Black-and-White
entries.description: 1953 high-key black-and-white: hard sun, dark filtered sky, blown white foam, wet sand mirroring the sky, silver grain and halation. It stages the kiss in the surf at Halona Cove; Clawd, playing the bugle on the lava rock, is the only colour.

entries.title: Ben Shahn Social Realism
entries.description: Ben Shahn's social realism: a trembling, blotted ink line over flat tempera blocks laid slightly off the drawing, big hands and long working faces, restrained slate, brick and ochre. Shahn painted dockers and union halls, which is this film's world.

entries.title: 1955 Kinescope on a Living-Room TV
entries.description: A 1955 kinescope playing on a wood-cabinet TV in a warm Bronx living room: scanlines, phosphor glow, a rounded bulging screen, ghosting and snow, all black-and-white except Clawd. Marty began as a live 1953 TV play, so the film is shown as television.

entries.title: 1950s UPA Modernist Cartoon
entries.title_zh: 50 年代 UPA 现代主义卡通
entries.description: A flat, geometric 1950s cartoon: colour blocks printed off their ink lines, broken outlines, crayon grain on cream paper. The film's own six-minute end-title animation was made by Saul Bass in this modernist style.

entries.title: Cyanotype Engineering Blueprint
aliases: The Bridge on the River Kwai
entries.description: A general-arrangement blueprint pinned to a drafting table: white lines on Prussian blue, folds, water stains, red-pencil revisions. The film is about a colonel obsessed with building a perfect bridge, so the bridge appears as his engineering drawing.
entries.film: The Bridge on the River Kwai

entries.title: Lautrec Belle Époque Lithograph
entries.title_zh: 罗特列克美好年代石印
entries.description: A Toulouse-Lautrec colour lithograph: flat poster colour, dry-brush contours, spattered ink instead of halftone, caricatured faces. Gigi's big moment is walking into Maxim's while all of Paris stares, and Lautrec drew exactly that Paris.

entries.title: 3D Circus Chariot Race, 65mm Epic
entries.title_zh: 3D 大竞技场战车赛 · 65mm 史诗
entries.description: A fully procedural 3D Circus in widescreen-epic light: hard desert sun, dust, marble and gold, a Technicolor grade and 65mm grain. The chariot race is the film's most famous sequence, so the scene is the race, under the poster's golden colossus.

entries.title: Saul Bass Line Titles in Black & White
entries.title_zh: Saul Bass 线条片头 · 黑白
entries.description: Saul Bass's sliding white lines on black build the endless one-point-perspective office of the film's best-known shot, then fill with grey tones. Bass designed this film's titles; the only warm colour is Clawd and its key tag.

entries.title: Technicolor 3D Stage Set
uses: 1961 poster: red sky, black fire escape
entries.description: A saturated, stage-like 3D block of the Upper West Side under a red-orange Technicolor sunset: red brick, zigzag fire escapes, rooftop water towers, posable dancers. It restages the aerial opening, the Jets' snaps and the poster's leap against the red sky.

entries.title: Terpning Epic Poster Gouache
entries.description: Painterly epic-poster gouache with visible directional strokes and a hard warm–cool split: amber sand against cobalt sky. Lawrence of Arabia's original poster was painted by Howard Terpning in exactly this manner.

entries.title: Hand-Coloured Georgian Satirical Print
entries.description: A Georgian satirical print: Hogarth's swelling burin lines and directional hatching under bright Rowlandson-style hand colour brushed slightly off the line, plus a speech balloon. The film itself imitates Hogarth's 18th-century England.

entries.title: Bob Peak Fashion Illustration
entries.description: Fast, dry-edged ink line with pink and magenta watercolour washes, splatter and edges fading to white paper. The original 1964 poster was Bob Peak's ink and pink; the scene is Cecil Beaton's black-and-white Ascot.

entries.title: Storybook 3D Alpine Aerial
entries.title_zh: 绘本感 3D 阿尔卑斯航拍
entries.description: Storybook 3D over procedural Alps: saturated emerald, cobalt and snow white, sculpted ridges, cotton-ball cumulus and gusts running through the grass. It restages the helicopter opening that ends on Maria spinning on the hilltop.

entries.title: Holbein Tudor Portrait in Oils
entries.title_zh: 霍尔拜因都铎肖像油画
entries.description: An Old Master oil portrait: smooth glazed modelling, fur painted hair by hair, velvet highlights, a gold chain link by link, varnish and craquelure. Holbein painted the real Thomas More in 1527, and this is his composition.

entries.title: Three-Ink Risograph Night
aliases: In the Heat of the Night
entries.description: A three-ink Risograph print in deep blue, poster orange-red and fluorescent pink, with halftone, grain and misregistration; light is printed as less ink. It echoes the 1967 poster's orange heat field and black silhouettes.
entries.film: In the Heat of the Night

entries.title: Victorian Toy Theatre
entries.description: A Victorian toy theatre: hand-coloured lithographed card figures with a white scissor margin, layered flats on wire slides, a gilt proscenium and flickering candle footlights throwing shadows up the scenery. Oliver! is a musical, staged here on the Victorian home stage.

entries.title: Warhol Photo-Silkscreen, Double Elvis
entries.title_zh: 沃霍尔照片丝网 · Double Elvis
entries.description: Warhol's photo-silkscreen: a black halftone photo printed unevenly over loose flat colour blocks on silver, the image repeated two and three times. The film has a Factory-style party in it, and his Elvis is a cowboy.

entries.title: WWII War-Bond Lithograph
entries.title_zh: 二战战争债券石印海报
entries.description: Flat-colour stone lithograph in the manner of 1940s US war-bond posters: posterised folds, a dark key line, halftone shadows, yellowed stock. It fits Patton's opening speech, where a tiny general stands before a stage-high flag.

entries.title: 16mm Chase Under the El
entries.title_zh: 高架铁下追车 · 16mm 颗粒 3D
entries.description: A full 3D Brooklyn avenue under the elevated railway, graded like grainy 16mm: cold grey, cyan shadows, high contrast, gate weave. The film is remembered for its car chase under the el, and only a real 3D world gives that speed.

entries.title: Rembrandt Top-Light Oil Painting
entries.description: Oil painting in deep amber and umber where only the top light is warm: thin transparent glazes in the darks, thick impasto on the lit edges. It recreates Gordon Willis's overhead light in the 'I believe in America' study.

entries.title: Saturday Evening Post Illustration
entries.description: Warm, clean magazine illustration in the Leyendecker–Rockwell line: blocky lit planes, parallel strokes, crisp dark contours. The Sting's own chapter cards imitate Saturday Evening Post covers, so its 1936 betting parlour is drawn the same way.

entries.title: Hand-Tinted Sepia Photograph
entries.description: A turn-of-the-century toned silver print with dyes brushed on by hand: sepia, soft lens, silver grain, foxing, a cracked corner, faint red, blue and verdigris. It shows young Vito arriving at Ellis Island in 1901, as in Lewis Hine's photographs.

entries.title: Hopper-Style American Realism
uses: flat oil planes with dragged strokes
aliases: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
entries.description: Quiet American realism after Edward Hopper: big flat planes of pale green, hard parallelograms of low morning sun, figures standing apart. It suits the ward of Cuckoo's Nest, fluorescent order broken by one act of escape.
entries.film: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

entries.title: Philadelphia Sunrise, 3D on 35mm
entries.title_zh: 费城台阶日出 3D · 35mm 调色
entries.description: A full 3D Philadelphia at sunrise, from meat locker to museum steps, graded like 1970s 35mm: cold blue sky, low gold sun, long shadows, haze, fine grain. The run up the 72 steps and the rising orbit at the top are what people remember.

entries.title: New Yorker Cartoon, Ink and Wash
entries.title_zh: 《纽约客》单格漫画 · 墨线淡彩
entries.description: A New Yorker single-panel cartoon: lively nib-pen lines, a few restrained washes, plenty of white paper and a hand-lettered caption beneath. Woody Allen's comedy shares the magazine's voice, and the lobster scene plays as one gag panel.

entries.title: Andrew Wyeth Egg Tempera
entries.description: Dry, finely hatched egg tempera after Andrew Wyeth: muted straw, umber and grey-green, grass drawn blade by blade, a pale empty sky. Wyeth was a Pennsylvania painter, and the 'one shot' hunt takes place in the Pennsylvania mountains above a steel town.

entries.title: Child's Wax-Crayon Drawing
entries.description: A kitchen drawn by a child in wax crayon: wobbly lines, colour pressed into the paper grain and over the edges, labels and arrows, a smiling sun. It is Billy's view of making French toast with his father.

entries.title: Autumn Transparent Watercolour
uses: Winslow Homer and John Singer Sargent
entries.description: Transparent watercolour in layered glazes: wet-in-wet sky and lake, tide-mark edges, blooms, white paper left for highlights, autumn gold and rust against cool grey-blue. It matches the quiet, sad Lake Forest autumn of the film's opening.

entries.title: 1924 Paris Olympics Stone Lithograph
entries.description: A four-colour stone lithograph after Jean Droit's 1924 Paris Olympics poster: classical bodies, a few inks, clumped stone grain, ragged registration on cream paper. Chariots of Fire builds to the 1924 Games, so its beach run becomes that poster coming to life.

entries.title: Rajasthani Hand Block Print
entries.title_zh: 拉贾斯坦手工木刻印花布
entries.description: Hand block print on cotton in indigo, madder and turmeric with a carved black key block, misregistered at the block seams, dye bleeding along the weave. Homespun khadi was Gandhi's symbol, so the Salt March is printed as cloth.

entries.title: Family Album Polaroids
entries.description: An open family album of faded Polaroids and Kodacolor snapshots, with teal-lifted blacks, creamy highlights and white borders, where one Polaroid comes alive as a panning shot of the beach drive. Terms of Endearment spans thirty years of a mother and daughter.

entries.title: Rococo Silhouettes in Gilt Candlelight
entries.title_zh: 洛可可剪影 · 烛光金色歌剧院
entries.description: Black paper profiles with gold-bronzed rims fill a horseshoe of gilt boxes and red velvet facing a starry stage. Amadeus peaks with Mozart's opening night, so one frame holds the pit, the stage, the audience and Salieri brooding in his box.

entries.title: 3D Biplane over the Rift Valley
entries.description: Real-time 3D flight over a soda lake: a chrome-yellow Gipsy Moth, thousands of flamingos lifting off, hazy amber light. The film's best-remembered sequence is Denys flying Karen over Kenya, down to the hand she reaches back across the cockpits.

entries.title: Combat Artist Field Sketch · Pen & Wash
entries.title_zh: 越战随军速写 · 钢笔淡彩
entries.description: Quick, hard pen lines with loose washes of olive, ochre, smoke grey and fire orange on sketchbook paper left bare at the edges. It reads as a war artist drawing on the spot, close to the film's infantryman's view of Vietnam.

entries.title: Gongbi Court Painting on Silk
entries.title_zh: 工笔重彩 · 绢本宫廷画
entries.description: Iron-wire outlines and graded mineral washes of azurite, malachite, cinnabar and gold on silk, with a ruled-line palace and thousands of kneeling officials. The boy emperor's coronation is a Qing court ceremony, painted the way Qing court painters recorded ceremonies.

entries.title: 80s Airbrush + Raymond's Count
entries.title_zh: 80 年代喷枪插画 + 雷蒙的计数
entries.description: Smooth airbrushed gradients, hard masked edges, chrome glints and pink-and-mint neon, overlaid with thin cyan callouts that count. It pairs the film's 1980s look with what Raymond sees: 82, 82, 82, 246 toothpicks, then cards counted at the table.

entries.title: Rockwell-style Oil Illustration
entries.description: Solid, warm Rockwell realism: clean edges, visible oil strokes, afternoon light through oaks, every neighbour busy with something. The film is two people in one car on a 1950s Atlanta street, which is a Saturday Evening Post cover already.

entries.title: Field Journal · Pencil & Watercolour
entries.title_zh: 邓巴日记 · 铅笔 + 透明水彩
entries.description: A soldier's field journal: pressure-varied pencil, transparent watercolour, yellowed rag paper, inked script and pencil notes in the margins. Dunbar writes and sketches in his diary throughout the film, so the prairie appears as his sketch coming to life.

entries.title: Hand-coloured Natural-history Copperplate
entries.title_zh: 手工上色的博物学铜版画
entries.description: Fine engraved hatching and stipple under thin hand-coloured tints, with plate numbers and Latin labels on yellowed paper. The poster's death's-head moth belongs on a specimen plate, and the same cold engraving carries on into Lecter's cell.

entries.title: Remington Western Oil · Sunset & Nocturne
entries.title_zh: 雷明顿西部油画 · 晚霞与雨夜
entries.description: Thick Western oil painting in two keys: Remington's red-gold plains at sunset and his blue-green nocturnes lit by warm windows. Unforgiven opens and closes on a silhouette at a grave against the sunset, and its showdown comes in a town on a rainy night.

entries.title: Black-and-white Film, One Red Coat
entries.title_zh: 黑白胶片 · 唯一的红大衣
entries.description: Cold, high-contrast black and white with coarse grain and haloed highlights, where only the girl's red coat and Clawd's orange keep their colour. It follows Spielberg's own device: the red coat and the Sabbath candle flames are the film's only colour.

entries.title: Sabuda Pop-up Book on a Real Desk
entries.title_zh: 立体书 · 真实书桌上的纸艺
entries.description: Printed cards standing up in parallel folds, with white cores, grey board edges, layered shadows and shallow focus, on a walnut desk. Forrest tells his life on a bench, so each page that pops up is one chapter.

entries.title: Illuminated Manuscript with Gold Leaf
entries.title_zh: 泥金手抄本 · 贴金细密画
entries.description: A medieval manuscript page: burnished gold with punched dots, lapis blue, vermilion, textura script, and a battle miniature framed like a window. Braveheart is a medieval Scottish legend, and its last cry, FREEDOM, becomes the illuminated initial.

entries.title: Explorer's Scrapbook Watercolour
entries.description: Watercolour sketches taped into an old book among maps, photos, notes and pressed flowers, in the poster's amber-sepia. Almásy's Herodotus, stuffed with his paintings and notes, frames the film, so the camera pushes through one painting into the Cave of Swimmers.

entries.title: Blueprint Developing into 3D Sunset
entries.description: White lines on Prussian-blue drafting paper stand up into perspective and develop into a full-colour 3D ship at sunset, then fall into night. The ship is the film's icon, so its yard drawing and the real ship are the same model.

entries.title: Hilliard Elizabethan Miniature
entries.title_zh: 希利亚德伊丽莎白细密画
entries.description: An Elizabethan portrait miniature in Nicholas Hilliard's manner: body colour on vellum, an ultramarine ground, shell-gold lettering, white eglantine. The film is set in Shakespeare's London, and the miniature was that court's own form of portrait.

entries.title: Suburban Symmetry + DV Camcorder
entries.title_zh: 郊区对称电影画面 + DV 录像
entries.description: Two looks cut together: a clean, saturated, dead-on shot of a suburban house with a red door and red roses, then soft, noisy camcorder video with a REC overlay. It mirrors the film's split between Lester's polished suburbia and Ricky's tape of the dancing bag.

entries.title: Roman Floor Mosaic
entries.description: Everything is laid in square stone and glass tesserae: courses follow the outlines, flat areas run in straight rows, gold-leaf tiles glint. The film's world is Rome, so the arena and Elysium are built as a Roman floor mosaic.

entries.title: Window Marker & Chalk, Gold Pattern
entries.title_zh: 窗上公式与黑板粉笔 + 金色连线
entries.description: Handwritten maths on two surfaces, white marker on a Gothic library window and chalk on slate, with digits that light up and join in gold lines. It shows Nash seeing patterns the way the film does: a light in his head, not a computer interface.

entries.title: Fosse Stage in Red and Black
entries.title_zh: 福斯舞台：红黑聚光剪影
entries.description: A black stage cut by hard spotlights: six cells with women in red-rimmed silhouette, a neon C, sequins, haze, and Clawd in a white follow spot. It is the 'Cell Block Tango' number from Rob Marshall's film, in the poster's red and black.

entries.title: Alan Lee Watercolour & Tolkien Map
entries.title_zh: 艾伦·李式水彩 + 托尔金地图
aliases: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
entries.description: Soft watercolour and pencil landscapes with deep aerial perspective, plus an ink map on stained parchment. Alan Lee and John Howe drew the films' concept art, so the journey is told the way the trilogy was first drawn.
entries.film: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

entries.title: 16-bit Arcade Fighting Game
entries.description: An original 16-bit arcade fighting-game screen: health bars, a round timer, ROUND 1 / FIGHT!, a combo counter, hit-stop and a big K.O. A boxing film about a shot at the title becomes one round told in arcade grammar.

entries.title: LA Night Light Trails & Snow
entries.title_zh: 洛杉矶夜景光轨 + 飘雪
entries.description: A polished night photograph made in code: freeway light trails in white and red, sodium orange against neon cyan, wet asphalt, bokeh, and snow that shows only where light hits it. Crash ends on a rare snowfall over Los Angeles.

entries.title: Street Stencil on Boston Brick
entries.title_zh: 波士顿红砖墙模板涂鸦
entries.description: Flat spray-paint stencil layers with overspray and drips, the paint sinking into brick mortar, beside a torn paste-up poster. The Departed ends on a rat crossing a railing below the State House dome, and street stencils have their own tradition of rats.

entries.title: 3D West Texas Dusk, Deakins Light
entries.title_zh: 3D 西德州荒原黄昏（迪金斯光）
entries.description: A real-time 3D West Texas at dusk: the sun pressed onto the horizon, long shadows toward the camera, desaturated ochre and grey-green, fine grain. It follows Roger Deakins' light for the Coens and the poster's backlit man with a case.

entries.title: Quiz-Show Studio & Mumbai Orange-Teal
entries.title_zh: 答题节目演播室 + 孟买橙青
uses: Anthony Dod Mantle orange and teal
entries.description: A hard-lit TV studio in blue-violet with gold highlights, moving-head beams and lens flares, then a hot orange-and-teal Mumbai rooftop. The film cuts between the quiz show's final question and the slums Jamal came from.

entries.title: EOD Technical Manual Line Art
entries.description: A page from an army bomb-disposal manual: even black lines, hatched shadows, stippled sand, numbered callouts, an exploded IED diagram, a little olive and sand. The Hurt Locker is about procedure under pressure, and a manual page is procedure drawn.

entries.title: Peeling Wall & Gold Broadcast Booth
entries.title_zh: 斑驳墙 + 金色广播间
entries.description: Painterly interiors with heavy wall texture: Logue's peeling, many-coloured wall in cool grey-green, then a padded broadcast booth in amber gold with a sprung microphone and fine gold sound waves. It follows Eve Stewart's famous wall and the poster's gold.

entries.title: Polished Silent-Film Black & White
entries.description: Clean, glossy black and white with bright highlights and soft greys, Art Deco intertitles, light flicker and grain; Clawd is the only colour. The Artist was a 2011 love letter to silent Hollywood, so this is a sharper, cleaner silent film than No. 1.

entries.title: Jack Kirby 70s Comic Page
entries.title_zh: 杰克·柯比 70 年代漫画页
entries.description: A 1970s Kirby comic book on a production desk: heavy ink, Kirby Krackle, Ben-Day dots on yellowed newsprint. The film's fake sci-fi movie was sold with real Kirby concept art, so the pages run from fake epic to the real runway escape.

entries.title: Cased Daguerreotype, Developing
entries.description: An 1850s silver-plate photograph in a brass mat and velvet case, developing from blank: a violin on a chair, Clawd beside it, head bowed. It is the photography of Solomon Northup's own time, and tells the film with one object and no people.

entries.title: 3D Backstage Long Take
entries.description: A detailed 3D backstage of a Broadway theatre shot as a handheld long take, warm tungsten against cold fluorescent, ending in the glare of Times Square. Birdman is remembered for looking like one unbroken shot, so the style is the camera move itself.

entries.title: Microfiche Reader, Newsprint Halftone
entries.title_zh: 缩微胶片阅读机 · 报纸网点
entries.description: A newspaper-halftone picture seen on the green-grey screen of a library microfiche reader, with scan lines, a rolling scan bar and dust on the glass. The reporters dug the story out of archives like this, and the fiche transport replaces the cuts.

entries.title: Moonlight-Blue Oil Portraiture
entries.description: Painted oil portraiture in saturated teal, magenta and moon-blue, with sculpted heads repainted in form-following strokes. It takes the film's title line, "in moonlight black boys look blue", literally.

entries.title: 3D Underwater Teal Caustics
uses: Projected caustics and volumetric light shafts
entries.description: A flooded 1960s bathroom and a lab tank in real-time 3D, soaked in teal with moving caustics, light shafts from above, bubbles and warm practical lamps. Del Toro's film lives in that green-blue water, so the whole segment is shot inside it.

entries.title: 1960s Linen Postcard
entries.description: A "Greetings from the Deep South" linen postcard that comes alive: woven paper texture, airbrushed saturated colour, chrome sparkles. The film is a 1962 road trip through the South, the same roads these cards sold to tourists.

entries.title: Architectural Section Axonometric
entries.description: One architectural section through a Seoul hillside: the glass house on top, a hidden bunker beneath, stairs down to a flooding half-basement, in fine lines and soft material colours. Parasite is built on that vertical class divide, so one drawing holds the film.

entries.title: Magic-Hour Soft Pastel
entries.description: Chalky soft-pastel strokes on grey-violet paper, the sky turning from gold to rose to violet over a wide plain with an old camper van. Nomadland lives in that long, empty horizon at dusk, and pastel keeps it soft and quiet.

entries.title: Scrimshaw on a Whale Tooth
entries.description: A polished sperm-whale tooth on an oak table, engraved in fine black lines with touches of red, blue and yellow: a Gloucester fishing boat, the family hauling nets, Ruby singing at the bow. It is the folk art of CODA's own New England coast.

entries.title: Ray-Marched Multiverse Jump-Cuts
entries.title_zh: 光线步进多元宇宙跳切
uses: One look per universe (office realism, cosmic surreal, landscape, commercial)
entries.description: Four universes, each with its own look, all ray-marched in real time: a cold-green IRS office, a hot-dog-finger piano lit like an advert, a silent canyon of googly-eyed rocks, the Everything Bagel as a black hole. A googly eye jumps between them.

entries.title: 3D Particle Fireball, IMAX Grain
entries.title_zh: 3D 粒子火球 · IMAX 颗粒
entries.description: The Trinity test site before dawn rebuilt in real-time 3D, with a fireball of about 720,000 particles, quantum visions of orbits and waves, deep pre-dawn blue against orange-gold fire and IMAX-style grain. Oppenheimer is built on that one light.

entries.title: Snowy Neon Night
entries.description: Glowing neon tubes in pink, cyan and orange, smeared into wet boardwalk planks and caught in falling snow, with bloom, bokeh and grain. Anora runs from Brighton Beach's Cyrillic neon to a Vegas wedding sign, so the whole segment is lit by tubes.

entries.title: 3D Dip-Road Chase, Long Lens
entries.title_zh: 3D 起伏公路追车 · 长焦压缩
entries.description: A real-time 3D desert road that rises and falls like a roller coaster, three cars chasing over the dips, shot through extreme long lenses with heat haze, bleached sunlight and fine grain. It rebuilds the film's best-known sequence, the dip-road chase.

entries.title: Caption News
entries.description: America lost 1.3 million bee colonies, yet the count rose 6 %: a news short that works with the sound off.
